blocks.content: You can convert distance in kilometers to miles using this formula:

Enter distance in km: 10
Distance in miles: 6.21

items: We use prompt() to get input from the user and convert it to a number using parseFloat().
We calculate the distance in miles by multiplying the kilometers by 0.621.
